书写方程式要配平，让两边原子数相等。: Equations must be balanced so that the numbers of atoms on both sides are equal.
碳在氧气中充分燃烧的化学方程式是？: What is the chemical equation for carbon burning completely in oxygen?
氧气不足时会生成一氧化碳。: When there is not enough oxygen, carbon monoxide forms.
高温煅烧石灰石的化学方程式是？: What is the chemical equation for strongly heating limestone?
这是工业制生石灰的方法。: This is the industrial method for making quicklime.
生物体结构和功能的基本单位是？: What is the basic unit of the structure and function of living things?
除病毒外，生物都由细胞构成。: Apart from viruses, all living things are made of cells.
植物细胞有而动物细胞没有的结构是？: What structures do plant cells have that animal cells do not?
所以植物细胞更“硬”，还能进行光合作用。: So plant cells are "harder" and can also carry out photosynthesis.
细胞中控制生物遗传的结构是？: Which structure in the cell controls heredity?
细胞核里有染色体，染色体上有 DNA。: The nucleus holds chromosomes, and the chromosomes carry DNA.
叶绿体里的叶绿素让叶子呈绿色。: The chlorophyll in chloroplasts makes leaves green.
光合作用的原料是？: What are the raw materials of photosynthesis?
产物是有机物（淀粉等）和氧气。: The products are organic matter (starch and so on) and oxygen.
光合作用的产物是？: What are the products of photosynthesis?
光合作用把光能转化成化学能储存起来。: Photosynthesis changes light energy into chemical energy and stores it.
呼吸作用主要在细胞的哪里进行？: Where in the cell does respiration mainly take place?
呼吸作用的实质是？: What is the essence of respiration?
分解有机物，释放能量: Breaking down organic matter and releasing energy
呼吸作用日夜都在进行。: Respiration goes on day and night.
植物的蒸腾作用主要通过什么散失水分？: Through what do plants mainly lose water in transpiration?
蒸腾作用能拉动水分向上运输，还能降温。: Transpiration can pull water upwards and also cools the plant.
植物体内运输水分和无机盐的是？: What carries water and inorganic salts in a plant?
导管自下而上运输水分。: Vessels carry water from the bottom upwards.
植物体内运输有机物的是？: What carries organic matter in a plant?
筛管自上而下运输叶制造的有机物。: Sieve tubes carry the organic matter made by the leaves from the top downwards.
根吸收水分的主要部位是？: Which main part of the root absorbs water?
根毛大大增加了吸收面积。: Root hairs greatly increase the surface for absorption.
种子萌发需要的外界条件是？: What outside conditions does a seed need to germinate?
适宜的温度、一定的水分、充足的空气: A suitable temperature, some water and enough air
种子萌发不一定需要光。: Seeds do not necessarily need light to germinate.
双子叶植物种子的营养物质储存在？: Where are the nutrients of a dicotyledon seed stored?
单子叶植物（如玉米）的营养主要在胚乳。: The nutrients of a monocotyledon (such as maize) are mainly in the endosperm.
花的哪一部分将来发育成果实？: Which part of a flower later develops into the fruit?
子房壁发育成果皮，胚珠发育成种子。: The ovary wall develops into the pericarp, and the ovules develop into seeds.
传粉的方式不包括？: Which of these is NOT a way of pollination?
玉米靠风，苹果花靠昆虫。: Maize relies on wind, and apple blossom on insects.
被子植物特有的受精方式叫？: What is the kind of fertilisation special to flowering plants called?
精子分别与卵细胞和极核结合。: One sperm joins the egg cell and the other joins the polar nuclei.
下列属于无性生殖的是？: Which of these is asexual reproduction?
嫁接能让果树保持优良品质。: Grafting lets fruit trees keep their good qualities.
蕨叶背面的褐色小点就是孢子囊。: The brown dots on the back of a fern frond are sporangia.
苔藓植物的特点是？: What are the features of mosses?
没有真正的根，叶片很薄: They have no true roots and their leaves are very thin
苔藓可以监测空气污染。: Mosses can be used to monitor air pollution.
动物界中种类最多的是？: Which group has the most kinds in the animal kingdom?
昆虫的种类占动物种类的一半以上。: Insects make up more than half of all kinds of animals.
昆虫身体分为哪三部分？: Into what three parts is an insect's body divided?
昆虫有三对足、两对翅（多数）。: Insects have three pairs of legs and (mostly) two pairs of wings.
哺乳动物的主要特征是？: What are the main features of mammals?
鲸、蝙蝠都是哺乳动物。: Whales and bats are both mammals.
鸟类适于飞行的特点是？: What features make birds suited to flight?
身体呈流线型、骨骼中空、有气囊: A streamlined body, hollow bones and air sacs
这样身体轻，飞行时消耗的能量少。: This makes the body light, so less energy is used in flying.
两栖动物幼体和成体分别用什么呼吸？: What do the young and the adult of amphibians breathe with?
幼体用鳃，成体用肺和皮肤: The young use gills; the adults use lungs and skin
青蛙的蝌蚪生活在水里，成蛙可以到陆地上。: Frog tadpoles live in water, and adult frogs can go onto land.
鱼在水里的运动器官主要是？: What is the main organ of movement of a fish in water?
尾鳍摆动提供前进动力。: The swinging of the tail fin provides the forward thrust.
蝙蝠是哺乳动物而不是鸟类，是因为它？: A bat is a mammal and not a bird because it...
胎生哺乳: Gives birth to live young and feeds them milk
蝙蝠的翼是前肢和皮膜形成的。: A bat's wing is formed by the forelimb and a skin membrane.
生态系统由什么组成？: What is an ecosystem made of?
生物部分和非生物部分: A living part and a non-living part
生物部分有生产者、消费者、分解者。: The living part has producers, consumers and decomposers.
生态系统中的生产者主要是？: What are the producers in an ecosystem mainly?
它们通过光合作用制造有机物。: They make organic matter by photosynthesis.
生态系统中的分解者主要是？: What are the decomposers in an ecosystem mainly?
它们把动植物遗体分解成无机物。: They break down the remains of animals and plants into inorganic matter.
食物链的起点是？: Where does a food chain start?
例如“草 → 兔 → 狐”，箭头指向捕食者。: For example "grass → rabbit → fox", the arrows point to the predator.
食物链中的箭头表示？: What do the arrows in a food chain show?
能量和物质流动的方向，被吃的指向吃的: The direction in which energy and matter flow, from the one eaten to the one that eats
例如草 → 兔，表示兔吃草。: For example grass → rabbit means the rabbit eats the grass.
吃的指向被吃的: From the one that eats to the one eaten
生物的亲缘关系: How closely living things are related
在食物链中，能量沿着食物链流动时？: As energy flows along a food chain...
所以食物链一般不会超过 4~5 个环节。: So a food chain generally does not have more than 4-5 links.
绿色植物对生物圈的重要作用不包括？: Which of these is NOT an important role of green plants in the biosphere?
植物被称为生物圈的“绿色工厂”。: Plants are called the "green factories" of the biosphere.
地球上最大的生态系统是？: What is the largest ecosystem on Earth?
生物圈包括大气圈底部、水圈和岩石圈上部。: The biosphere includes the bottom of the atmosphere, the hydrosphere and the top of the lithosphere.
被称为“地球之肺”的生态系统是？: Which ecosystem is called the "lungs of the Earth"?
森林吸收二氧化碳，释放大量氧气。: Forests absorb carbon dioxide and release a lot of oxygen.
被称为“地球之肾”的生态系统是？: Which ecosystem is called the "kidneys of the Earth"?
湿地能净化水质，调节气候。: Wetlands can purify water quality and regulate the climate.
人体最大的器官是？: What is the largest organ of the human body?
成年人的皮肤面积约 1.5~2 平方米。: The skin of an adult has an area of about 1.5-2 square metres.
人体最大的内脏器官是？: What is the largest internal organ of the human body?
肝脏能分泌胆汁，帮助消化脂肪。: The liver secretes bile, which helps to digest fat.
消化和吸收营养物质的主要场所是？: What is the main place where nutrients are digested and absorbed?
小肠长约 5~6 米，内壁有许多绒毛。: The small intestine is about 5-6 metres long and has many villi on its inner wall.
开始消化淀粉的器官是？: Which organ starts to digest starch?
馒头越嚼越甜，因为唾液把淀粉分解成麦芽糖。: The longer you chew a steamed bun, the sweeter it gets, because saliva breaks starch down into maltose.
开始消化蛋白质的器官是？: Which organ starts to digest protein?
胃液里有胃蛋白酶和盐酸。: Gastric juice contains pepsin and hydrochloric acid.
脂肪被消化需要什么帮助？: What helps fat to be digested?
胆汁由肝脏分泌，储存在胆囊。: Bile is secreted by the liver and stored in the gall bladder.
人体的“六大营养素”不包括？: Which of these is NOT one of the "six major nutrients" of the human body?
还有糖类、脂肪、无机盐。: The others are carbohydrates, fats and inorganic salts.
缺乏维生素 C 会患？: A lack of vitamin C causes...
新鲜的蔬菜水果富含维生素 C。: Fresh vegetables and fruit are rich in vitamin C.
缺乏维生素 A 会患？: A lack of vitamin A causes...
胡萝卜、动物肝脏富含维生素 A。: Carrots and animal liver are rich in vitamin A.
缺钙的儿童容易患？: Children who lack calcium easily get...
补钙的同时要补维生素 D。: When taking calcium you also need vitamin D.
缺铁容易患？: A lack of iron easily causes...
铁是血红蛋白的重要成分。: Iron is an important component of haemoglobin.
缺碘容易患？: A lack of iodine easily causes...
食盐里加碘就是为了预防它。: Adding iodine to table salt is precisely to prevent it.
血细胞有红细胞、白细胞、血小板。: Blood cells include red cells, white cells and platelets.
红细胞里的血红蛋白能与氧结合。: The haemoglobin in red cells can combine with oxygen.
白细胞是身体的“卫士”。: White blood cells are the body's "guards".
有止血和加速凝血作用的血细胞是？: Which blood cells stop bleeding and speed up clotting?
血小板很小，没有细胞核。: Platelets are very small and have no nucleus.
心脏有几个腔？: How many chambers does the heart have?
左右心房、左右心室。: Left and right atria, left and right ventricles.
体循环的起点是？: Where does the systemic circulation start?
血液从左心室出发，最后回到右心房。: Blood leaves from the left ventricle and finally returns to the right atrium.
肺循环的起点是？: Where does the pulmonary circulation start?
血液在肺里由静脉血变成动脉血。: In the lungs, blood changes from venous blood to arterial blood.
肺泡适于气体交换的特点是？: What feature of the alveoli makes them suited to gas exchange?
壁很薄，外面包着毛细血管: Their walls are very thin and are wrapped in capillaries
肺泡数量多，总面积大。: There are many alveoli, with a large total area.
数量很少: There are very few of them
吸气时，膈肌和肋间肌？: When breathing in, the diaphragm and the intercostal muscles...
胸廓扩大，外面的空气被吸进肺里。: The chest cavity gets bigger, and air from outside is drawn into the lungs.
人体产生尿液的器官是？: Which organ of the body makes urine?
肾单位是肾脏结构和功能的基本单位。: The nephron is the basic unit of the structure and function of the kidney.
人体的神经系统由什么组成？: What is the human nervous system made of?
脑、脊髓和神经: The brain, the spinal cord and nerves
脑和脊髓是中枢神经系统。: The brain and spinal cord are the central nervous system.
脊髓和血管: The spinal cord and blood vessels
调节人体平衡的是脑的哪一部分？: Which part of the brain regulates balance in the body?
喝醉酒后走路不稳，就是小脑受影响。: Walking unsteadily after drinking too much shows that the cerebellum is affected.
控制呼吸、心跳的“生命中枢”在？: Where is the "life centre" that controls breathing and heartbeat?
脑干受伤会危及生命。: Injury to the brain stem can endanger life.
膝跳反射的神经中枢在？: Where is the nerve centre of the knee-jerk reflex?
这是不需要大脑参与的简单反射。: This is a simple reflex that does not need the brain.
反射的结构基础是？: What is the structural basis of a reflex?
反射弧由感受器、传入神经、神经中枢、传出神经、效应器组成。: A reflex arc is made of a receptor, a sensory nerve, a nerve centre, a motor nerve and an effector.
“谈虎色变”属于什么反射？: What kind of reflex is "turning pale at the mention of a tiger"?
人类特有的是对语言文字的反射。: What is special to humans is the reflex to spoken and written language.
胰岛素由胰岛分泌，能降低血糖。: Insulin is secreted by the islets of Langerhans and can lower blood sugar.
幼年时生长激素分泌不足会患？: Too little growth hormone in childhood causes...
生长激素由垂体分泌。: Growth hormone is secreted by the pituitary gland.
男性为 XY，女性为 XX。: Males are XY and females are XX.
生男生女的机会是？: What are the chances of having a boy or a girl?
取决于是含 X 还是含 Y 的精子与卵细胞结合。: It depends on whether a sperm carrying X or Y joins the egg cell.
由母亲决定: It is decided by the mother
人体细胞中有多少对染色体？: How many pairs of chromosomes are there in human cells?
即 46 条，一半来自父亲，一半来自母亲。: That is 46, half from the father and half from the mother.
遗传物质 DNA 的结构是？: What is the structure of the genetic material DNA?
1953 年沃森和克里克提出了 DNA 双螺旋结构。: In 1953 Watson and Crick proposed the double helix structure of DNA.
孟德尔通过什么植物实验发现了遗传规律？: With which plant did Mendel discover the laws of heredity?
豌豆是自花传粉，闭花受粉，容易观察。: Peas are self-pollinating and pollinate in the closed flower, so they are easy to observe.
显性基因和隐性基因同时存在时，表现出来的是？: When a dominant gene and a recessive gene are both present, which shows?
只有两个隐性基因时才表现隐性性状。: The recessive trait shows only when there are two recessive genes.
适者生存，不适者被淘汰。: The fittest survive and the unfit are eliminated.
生物进化的总体趋势是？: What is the overall trend of the evolution of living things?
从简单到复杂，从低等到高等，从水生到陆生: From simple to complex, from lower to higher, from aquatic to land-living
化石是生物进化最直接的证据。: Fossils are the most direct evidence of evolution.
脊椎动物进化顺序：鱼类、两栖、爬行、鸟类和哺乳类。: The order of vertebrate evolution: fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals.
他发现青霉菌能杀死细菌。: He found that the Penicillium mould could kill bacteria.
酵母菌可以用来做什么？: What can yeast be used for?
发面、酿酒: Making dough rise and making alcoholic drinks
酵母菌发酵产生二氧化碳，使面团膨大。: Yeast ferments and produces carbon dioxide, which makes the dough swell.
乳酸菌可以用来做什么？: What can lactic acid bacteria be used for?
乳酸菌在无氧条件下发酵产生乳酸。: Lactic acid bacteria ferment without oxygen and produce lactic acid.
病毒没有什么结构？: What structure do viruses not have?
病毒必须寄生在活细胞里才能繁殖。: A virus must live as a parasite in a living cell in order to reproduce.
预防传染病的措施不包括？: Which of these is NOT a measure for preventing infectious diseases?
接种疫苗属于保护易感人群。: Vaccination is protecting the susceptible population.
切断传播途径: Cutting off the routes of transmission
接种疫苗能让人体产生什么？: What does vaccination make the human body produce?
抗体能特异性地识别并消灭病原体。: Antibodies can specifically recognise and destroy pathogens.
世界上第一个发明牛痘接种预防天花的人是？: Who was the first person in the world to invent cowpox vaccination to prevent smallpox?
吸烟对人体最大的危害是？: What is the greatest harm of smoking to the human body?
损害呼吸系统，增加患肺癌的风险: It harms the respiratory system and increases the risk of lung cancer
青少年更应远离烟草。: Young people should keep away from tobacco even more.
我们的国家全称是中华人民共和国。: The full name of our country is the People's Republic of China.
中国的国旗是什么颜色的底？: What colour is the background of China's national flag?
国旗上有五颗黄色的五角星。: The flag has five yellow five-pointed stars.
国旗上一共有几颗星？: How many stars are there on the national flag altogether?
一颗大星和四颗小星。: One big star and four small stars.
地图上通常上面是哪个方向？: Which direction is usually at the top of a map?
上北下南，左西右东。: North is up, south is down, west is left and east is right.
地图上通常右边是哪个方向？: Which direction is usually on the right of a map?
早晨太阳从哪个方向升起？: From which direction does the Sun rise in the morning?
太阳东升西落。: The Sun rises in the east and sets in the west.
傍晚太阳在哪个方向落下？: In which direction does the Sun set in the evening?
看着太阳落下的方向，就是西。: The direction in which you see the Sun go down is west.
我们居住的星球叫什么？: What is the planet we live on called?
地球是一个蓝色的星球，因为有很多水。: The Earth is a blue planet because it has a lot of water.
地球表面大部分是什么？: What is most of the Earth's surface?
海洋大约占地球表面的十分之七。: Oceans make up about seven tenths of the Earth's surface.
中国最长的河流是哪条？: Which is the longest river in China?
长江全长六千多千米。: The Yangtze is more than six thousand kilometres long.
被称为“母亲河”的是哪条河？: Which river is called the "Mother River"?
黄河孕育了古老的中华文明。: The Yellow River gave birth to the ancient Chinese civilisation.
中国的万里长城在哪个方向？: In which direction is China's Great Wall?
长城是古人为了防御而修建的。: The Great Wall was built by people in ancient times for defence.
在沙漠中间: In the middle of a desert
四川的卧龙是大熊猫的家乡。: Wolong in Sichuan is the home of the giant panda.
一年中最热的季节是？: What is the hottest season of the year?
夏天白天长，太阳光照得最久。: In summer the days are long and the Sun shines for the longest time.
一年中最冷的季节是？: What is the coldest season of the year?
北方的冬天会下很大的雪。: In winter in the north there is heavy snow.
树叶变黄、落下来，是哪个季节？: In which season do leaves turn yellow and fall?
秋天是收获的季节。: Autumn is the season of harvest.
小草发芽、花儿开放，是哪个季节？: In which season does the grass sprout and flowers open?
春天万物复苏。: In spring everything comes back to life.
黑龙江的冬天很冷，会下什么？: Winter in Heilongjiang is very cold. What falls there?
哈尔滨每年冬天都有冰雪节。: Harbin has an Ice and Snow Festival every winter.
海南岛在中国的哪个方向？: In which direction is Hainan Island in China?
那里冬天也不冷，有椰子树。: It is not cold there even in winter, and there are coconut trees.
沙漠里最缺少什么？: What is most lacking in a desert?
骆驼被称为“沙漠之舟”。: The camel is called the "ship of the desert".
海边常见的东西是什么？: What is commonly seen by the sea?
海浪把贝壳冲到沙滩上。: The waves wash the shells onto the beach.
大海里的水是什么味道？: What does the water in the sea taste like?
海水里溶解了很多盐。: Many salts are dissolved in sea water.
春节一般在公历的哪两个月之间？: Between which two months of the Gregorian calendar does the Spring Festival usually fall?
春节要吃饺子、贴春联、放鞭炮。: At the Spring Festival people eat dumplings, put up spring couplets and set off firecrackers.
北极熊有厚厚的毛，不怕冷。: Polar bears have thick fur and are not afraid of the cold.
企鹅不会飞，但是很会游泳。: Penguins cannot fly, but they are very good swimmers.
地图上蓝色一般表示什么？: What does blue on a map generally mean?
地图上的绿色常表示平原和森林。: Green on a map often means plains and forests.
我们每个人都生活在哪里？: Where does each one of us live?
一个家庭、一个社区: In a family and a community
我们的家在社区，社区在城市里。: Our home is in a community, and the community is in a city.
海底: At the bottom of the sea
从家到学校，需要看什么才不会迷路？: What do you need to look at to avoid getting lost on the way from home to school?
会看地图的人不容易迷路。: People who can read a map do not easily get lost.
过马路时要看什么灯？: What light should you look at when crossing the road?
红灯停，绿灯行。: Red light stop, green light go.
红灯亮了，我们应该怎么做？: When the red light comes on, what should we do?
看见红灯就停，这是交通规则。: Stopping when you see a red light is a traffic rule.
长江流入哪里？: Where does the Yangtze River flow into?
上海就在长江入海口。: Shanghai is right at the mouth of the Yangtze.
山顶上的气温比山脚下怎么样？: How is the air temperature at the top of a mountain compared with at the foot?
越往高处越冷，所以高山顶上常年有雪。: The higher you go, the colder it gets, so high mountain tops have snow all year round.
台湾是中国不可分割的一部分。: Taiwan is an inseparable part of China.
中国的东面是什么？: What is to the east of China?
中国东部和南部有长长的海岸线。: The east and south of China have long coastlines.
哪个城市有东方明珠塔？: Which city has the Oriental Pearl Tower?
东方明珠塔高 468 米。: The Oriental Pearl Tower is 468 metres high.
哪个城市有故宫？: Which city has the Forbidden City?
故宫以前是皇帝住的地方。: The Forbidden City used to be where the emperors lived.
兵马俑在哪个城市附近？: Near which city are the Terracotta Warriors?
兵马俑有成千上万个陶做的士兵。: There are thousands of soldiers made of clay in the Terracotta Army.
西湖在哪个城市？: In which city is West Lake?
西湖风景优美，有“人间天堂”的美誉。: West Lake has beautiful scenery and is praised as "heaven on earth".
我们的地球绕着什么转？: What does our Earth go round?
地球绕太阳转一圈就是一年。: The Earth going once round the Sun is one year.
地球自己转一圈是多长时间？: How long does it take the Earth to turn once on its own?
地球自转一圈就是一昼夜。: One turn of the Earth on its axis is one day and night.
为什么会有白天和黑夜？: Why are there day and night?
朝着太阳的一面是白天，背着太阳的是黑夜。: The side facing the Sun has day, and the side facing away has night.
因为月亮在追太阳: Because the Moon is chasing the Sun
地图上的比例尺告诉我们什么？: What does the scale on a map tell us?
图上的距离和实际距离的比: The ratio of the distance on the map to the real distance
有了比例尺，就能算出两地有多远。: With the scale you can work out how far apart two places are.
非洲有一种很高的动物叫什么？: What is a very tall animal of Africa called?
长颈鹿是陆地上最高的动物。: The giraffe is the tallest animal on land.
袋鼠生活在哪个大洲？: On which continent do kangaroos live?
袋鼠妈妈有一个育儿袋。: A mother kangaroo has a pouch for her young.
世界上最大的洲是哪个？: Which is the biggest continent in the world?
世界上一共有几个大洋？: How many oceans are there in the world altogether?
太平洋、大西洋、印度洋、北冰洋。: The Pacific, Atlantic, Indian and Arctic Oceans.
世界上最大的大洋是哪个？: Which is the biggest ocean in the world?
太平洋比所有陆地加起来还要大。: The Pacific Ocean is bigger than all the land put together.
下雨天出门要带什么？: What should you take when you go out on a rainy day?
打雷时不要在大树下躲雨。: When there is thunder, do not shelter from the rain under a big tree.
夏天太阳很大，出门要做什么？: The summer Sun is strong. What should you do when you go out?
戴帽子、涂防晒: Wear a hat and put on sun protection
阳光太强会晒伤皮肤。: Very strong sunshine can burn the skin.
冬天出门要穿什么？: What should you wear when you go out in winter?
冬天要注意保暖，不要感冒。: In winter take care to keep warm and do not catch a cold.
台风来的时候，我们应该怎么做？: When a typhoon comes, what should we do?
待在家里，不要出门: Stay at home and do not go out
台风会带来大风和大雨。: A typhoon brings strong wind and heavy rain.
去海边看浪: Go to the seaside to watch the waves
去山上玩: Go to the mountains to play
地震时在室内应该怎么做？: What should you do indoors in an earthquake?
躲在桌子下，保护好头部: Hide under a table and protect your head
地震时不要乘电梯。: Do not take the lift in an earthquake.
看到彩虹，一般是在什么时候？: When do you usually see a rainbow?
雨过天晴时: When the sky clears after rain
太阳光穿过小水珠就形成了彩虹。: Sunlight passing through small water droplets forms a rainbow.
我们生活的社区里，谁负责灭火和救人？: In the community where we live, who is responsible for putting out fires and rescuing people?
遇到火灾，应该拨打哪个电话？: Which number should you dial in a fire?
110 是报警，120 是急救。: 110 is for the police and 120 is for an ambulance.
需要警察帮忙时，应该拨打哪个电话？: Which number should you dial when you need help from the police?
迷路了也可以找警察叔叔。: If you are lost you can also ask a police officer.
有人生病需要救护车，应该拨打哪个电话？: Which number should you dial when someone is ill and needs an ambulance?
说清楚地点和病情。: Say clearly the place and the illness.
一颗会发光发热的恒星: A star that gives out light and heat
太阳给地球带来光和热。: The Sun brings light and heat to the Earth.
月亮自己会发光吗？: Does the Moon give out light by itself?
不会，它反射太阳的光: No, it reflects the Sun's light
月亮像一面大镜子，把太阳光反射给我们。: The Moon is like a big mirror that reflects the Sun's light to us.
晚上天空中能看到什么？: What can we see in the sky at night?
白天太阳太亮，星星看不见。: In the day the Sun is too bright, so the stars cannot be seen.
水有哪三种常见的样子？: What are the three common forms of water?
冰是固体，水蒸气是气体。: Ice is a solid and water vapour is a gas.
水结成冰需要怎样？: What does water need to freeze into ice?
放进盐里: To have salt put in it
冰遇到热会变成什么？: What does ice turn into when it meets heat?
冰融化了，就变回了水。: When ice melts, it turns back into water.
烧开水时冒出的白气是什么？: What is the white mist that appears when water is boiled?
水蒸气遇冷变成了小水珠。: Water vapour cools and turns into small water droplets.
下雨时，雨水是从哪里来的？: When it rains, where does the rain come from?
云里的小水滴变大后就落下来了。: The small droplets in a cloud grow bigger and then fall.
打雷之前，我们总是先看到什么？: Before thunder, what do we always see first?
我们看不到空气，但能感受到风。: We cannot see air, but we can feel the wind.
我们呼吸需要什么？: What do we need for breathing?
空气里有我们需要的氧气。: Air has the oxygen we need.
种子发芽首先需要什么？: What does a seed need first in order to sprout?
种子吸水后才能萌发。: A seed can only germinate after it has taken up water.
植物的根有什么作用？: What do the roots of a plant do?
吸收水分，固定植物: They take up water and hold the plant in place
根深才能叶茂。: Only with deep roots can leaves flourish.
植物的叶子能做什么？: What can the leaves of a plant do?
花谢了以后，会长出什么？: After the flower fades, what grows?
果实里面有种子。: There are seeds inside the fruit.
向日葵的花盘总是朝着哪里？: Which way does the flower head of a sunflower always face?
所以它叫向日葵。: That is why it is called the "sun-facing flower" (sunflower).
蝌蚪长大后会变成什么？: What does a tadpole turn into when it grows up?
青蛙会先长出后腿，再长出前腿。: A frog first grows its back legs, and then its front legs.
毛毛虫长大后会变成什么？: What does a caterpillar turn into when it grows up?
毛毛虫要先变成蛹。: A caterpillar first has to turn into a pupa.
小鸡是从什么里面孵出来的？: What does a chick hatch out of?
母鸡会用体温孵蛋，大约 21 天。: A hen hatches eggs with her body heat, which takes about 21 days.
青蛙是庄稼的好朋友。: Frogs are good friends of crops.
蜜蜂采蜜时，还帮花做了什么？: When bees collect nectar, what else do they do for flowers?
没有蜜蜂，很多水果就长不出来。: Without bees, many fruits could not grow.
燕子冬天会飞到哪里？: Where do swallows fly in winter?
小熊冬天会怎么做？: What does a bear do in winter?
冬眠时它们几乎不吃不动。: When hibernating they hardly eat or move.
鱼把水里的氧气吸收进身体。: Fish take the oxygen in the water into their bodies.
鸟的身上长着什么？: What grows on a bird's body?
羽毛帮助鸟飞翔和保暖。: Feathers help birds fly and keep warm.
下面哪个是会飞的动物？: Which of these is an animal that can fly?
蝙蝠是会飞的哺乳动物。: The bat is a mammal that can fly.
我们的五官中，用来听声音的是？: Of our five sense organs, which is used to hear sounds?
保护耳朵，不要用尖东西掏耳朵。: Protect your ears; do not poke them with sharp things.
我们的五官中，用来闻气味的是？: Of our five sense organs, which is used to smell?
感冒时鼻子堵了，就闻不出香味。: When your nose is blocked with a cold, you cannot smell fragrances.
我们用什么来尝味道？: What do we use to taste flavours?
舌头能尝出酸、甜、苦、咸。: The tongue can taste sour, sweet, bitter and salty.
我们用什么来感觉冷热和软硬？: What do we use to feel hot and cold, and soft and hard?
皮肤是我们最大的器官。: The skin is our biggest organ.
每天早晚应该刷牙几次？: How many times a day should you brush your teeth, morning and evening?
睡前刷牙特别重要。: Brushing before bed is especially important.
看书时眼睛离书本应该大约多远？: About how far should your eyes be from the book when you read?
保护视力，不要在昏暗处看书。: To protect your eyesight, do not read in dim light.
吃饭的时候应该怎样？: How should you behave when eating?
吃得慢，对肠胃好。: Eating slowly is good for the stomach and intestines.
多吃蔬菜身体棒。: Eat more vegetables to have a strong body.
水果里有很多维生素。: Fruit has a lot of vitamins.
磁铁能吸住下面哪个东西？: Which of these things can a magnet attract?
磁铁能吸住含铁的东西。: A magnet can attract things that contain iron.
下面哪个物体在水里会浮起来？: Which of these objects will float in water?
重的不一定沉，要看密度。: Heavy things do not necessarily sink; it depends on density.
下面哪个物体在水里会沉下去？: Which of these objects will sink in water?
石头比同样大小的水重。: A stone is heavier than the same size of water.
糖放进水里搅一搅，会怎么样？: What happens when you put sugar into water and stir?
糖溶解在水里，水变甜了。: Sugar dissolves in water and the water becomes sweet.
在阳光下，物体后面会出现什么？: In the sunshine, what appears behind an object?
光被物体挡住，就形成影子。: When light is blocked by an object, a shadow forms.
一天中，影子最短的时候是什么时候？: At what time of day are shadows shortest?
中午太阳最高，影子最短。: At noon the Sun is highest and shadows are shortest.
镜子里的像和我们自己相比？: How does the image in a mirror compare with ourselves?
举起右手，镜子里的“人”举起了左手。: Raise your right hand and the "person" in the mirror raises their left hand.
摸一摸正在响的鼓，能感觉到它在振动。: Touch a drum that is sounding and you can feel it vibrating.
声音的大小叫什么？: What is the size of a sound called?
用力敲鼓，声音更大。: Hit a drum hard and the sound is louder.
声音要靠什么才能传播？: What does sound need in order to travel?
空气、水等物质: Substances such as air and water
太空中没有空气，所以在太空中听不到声音。: There is no air in space, so no sound can be heard in space.
烧水的壶口冒热气，摸上去会怎么样？: Steam comes out of the spout of a kettle of boiling water. What is it like to touch?
很烫，不能碰: Very hot; do not touch it
要远离热水和热气，避免烫伤。: Keep away from hot water and steam to avoid scalds.
不能用湿手去碰什么？: What must you not touch with wet hands?
水能导电，湿手摸电会触电。: Water conducts electricity, and touching electricity with wet hands gives an electric shock.
电池有哪两个极？: What are the two poles of a battery?
一节电池的正极在有凸起的那一头。: The positive pole of a cell is the end with the bump.
东极和西极: The east pole and the west pole
上极和下极: The upper pole and the lower pole
红极和蓝极: The red pole and the blue pole
地球上的垃圾，哪种应该放进“可回收物”桶？: Which of the rubbish should go into the "recyclables" bin?
废电池应该放进哪个垃圾桶？: Which bin should used batteries go into?
电池里的重金属会污染土壤和水。: The heavy metals in batteries pollute soil and water.
剩饭剩菜应该放进哪个垃圾桶？: Which bin should leftover food go into?
厨余垃圾可以做成肥料。: Kitchen waste can be made into fertiliser.
洗手后要及时做什么，节约用水？: After washing your hands, what should you do promptly to save water?
离开房间时，应该怎么做来节约用电？: What should you do when leaving a room to save electricity?
节约用电就是保护环境。: Saving electricity is protecting the environment.
春天植树是为了？: Why are trees planted in spring?
美化环境、保护地球: To beautify the environment and protect the Earth
植树节是每年的 3 月 12 日。: Arbor Day is on 12 March every year.
彩虹有几种颜色？: How many colours does a rainbow have?
红橙黄绿青蓝紫。: Red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, violet.
美术课上，红、黄、蓝通常被称为什么？: In art class, what are red, yellow and blue usually called?
红加黄变橙，黄加蓝变绿。: Red plus yellow makes orange, and yellow plus blue makes green.
红色和黄色混在一起变成什么颜色？: What colour do you get when red and yellow are mixed?
颜料的颜色可以互相调和。: Paint colours can be mixed with one another.
黄色和蓝色混在一起变成什么颜色？: What colour do you get when yellow and blue are mixed?
画画时可以自己调出新的颜色。: When painting you can mix new colours yourself.
红色和蓝色混在一起变成什么颜色？: What colour do you get when red and blue are mixed?
紫色是红色和蓝色调出来的。: Purple is made by mixing red and blue.
圆圆的太阳挂在天上。: The round Sun hangs in the sky.
一周有几天？: How many days are there in a week?
一年有几个月？: How many months are there in a year?
有的月份 31 天，有的 30 天。: Some months have 31 days and some have 30.
一天有多少小时？: How many hours are there in a day?
白天和黑夜加起来是一天。: Day and night together make one day.
钟表上短针指的是什么？: What does the short hand on a clock show?
长针走一圈，短针走一格。: When the long hand goes once round, the short hand moves one mark.
钟表上长针走一圈是多长时间？: How long does it take the long hand of a clock to go once round?
我们用什么来测量温度？: What do we use to measure temperature?
温度计能告诉我们天气冷还是热。: A thermometer can tell us whether the weather is cold or hot.
我们用什么来称物体有多重？: What do we use to weigh how heavy an object is?
厨房里常用电子秤。: An electronic scale is often used in the kitchen.
我们用什么来量物体有多长？: What do we use to measure how long an object is?
一把直尺通常长 15 厘米或 20 厘米。: A straight ruler is usually 15 cm or 20 cm long.
乌龟的壳有什么用？: What is a tortoise's shell for?
遇到危险，乌龟会缩进壳里。: When in danger, a tortoise pulls into its shell.
改变身体的颜色: Change the colour of its body
变色能帮它隐藏，也能表达心情。: Changing colour helps it hide and also shows its mood.
大象的长鼻子可以做什么？: What can an elephant's long trunk do?
大象的鼻子又长又灵活。: An elephant's trunk is long and very flexible.
小蝌蚪找妈妈的故事里，小蝌蚪的妈妈是谁？: In the story "Little Tadpoles Look for Their Mother", who is the tadpoles' mother?
这是一个关于动物成长的故事。: This is a story about how animals grow.
蚂蚁搬家，常常是因为感觉到了什么变化？: When ants move house, what change are they often sensing?
空气变得潮湿，快要下雨了: The air is becoming damp and it is about to rain
民间有“蚂蚁搬家，天将下雨”的说法，这是因为蚂蚁对空气湿度很敏感。: Folk wisdom says, “When ants move house, rain is on the way”, because ants are very sensitive to air humidity.
昆虫有六条腿，蜘蛛有八条腿。: Insects have six legs and spiders have eight legs.
细胞分裂时，最先发生变化的是？: When a cell divides, what changes first?
细胞核里的染色体先复制，再平均分配。: The chromosomes in the nucleus copy themselves first and are then shared out equally.
细胞分裂后，新细胞的染色体数目与母细胞相比？: After a cell divides, how does the number of chromosomes in the new cells compare with the mother cell?
这保证了遗传物质的稳定。: This keeps the genetic material stable.
细胞分化的结果是形成什么？: What is the result of cell differentiation?
细胞分化使细胞在形态和功能上出现差异。: Cell differentiation makes cells differ in shape and function.
更多相同的细胞: More cells that are all the same
人体的结构层次由小到大依次是？: What is the order of the levels of structure of the human body, from small to large?
细胞→组织→器官→系统→人体: Cell → tissue → organ → system → human body
植物没有“系统”这一层。: Plants do not have the "system" level.
细胞→器官→组织→系统→人体: Cell → organ → tissue → system → human body
组织→细胞→器官→系统→人体: Tissue → cell → organ → system → human body
细胞→组织→系统→器官→人体: Cell → tissue → system → organ → human body
植物体的结构层次是？: What is the order of the levels of structure of a plant?
植物的器官有根、茎、叶、花、果实、种子。: The organs of a plant are the root, stem, leaf, flower, fruit and seed.
精子和卵细胞结合形成的细胞叫什么？: What is the cell formed when a sperm and an egg cell join called?
受精卵是新生命的起点。: The fertilised egg is the starting point of a new life.
受精卵形成的场所是？: Where does the fertilised egg form?
之后受精卵移动到子宫内发育。: Afterwards the fertilised egg moves into the uterus to develop.
胎儿通过什么从母体获得营养和氧气？: Through what does a foetus get nutrients and oxygen from the mother's body?
胎盘和脐带: The placenta and the umbilical cord
胎儿的废物也通过胎盘排出。: The foetus's waste is also removed through the placenta.
青春期身体发育的显著特点是？: What is the most notable feature of body development in puberty?
身高突增: A sudden growth spurt in height
青春期也是性器官发育和心理变化的时期。: Puberty is also a time of development of the sex organs and psychological change.
青春期出现的第二性征，下列属于男性的是？: Among the secondary sexual characteristics that appear in puberty, which belongs to males?
喉结突出、长胡须: A prominent Adam's apple and a growing beard
这是性激素作用的结果。: This is the result of the action of sex hormones.
亲子间的相似性: The similarity between parents and offspring
“龙生龙，凤生凤”说的就是遗传。: "Dragons give birth to dragons, phoenixes to phoenixes" is about heredity.
亲子间的差异: The differences between parents and offspring
亲子间和子代个体间的差异: The differences between parents and offspring and among the offspring
“一母生九子，九子各不同”。: "One mother has nine sons, and the nine are all different."
亲子间的相似: The similarity between parents and offspring
下列哪种变异是可以遗传的？: Which kind of variation can be inherited?
由遗传物质改变引起的: One caused by a change in the genetic material
遗传物质改变引起的变异才能遗传给后代。: Only variation caused by a change in the genetic material can be passed on to the next generation.
有遗传效应的 DNA 片段: A piece of DNA with a genetic effect
基因控制生物的性状。: Genes control the traits of living things.
染色体主要由什么组成？: What are chromosomes mainly made of?
DNA 是主要的遗传物质。: DNA is the main genetic material.
生殖细胞（精子、卵细胞）中染色体的数目是体细胞的？: The number of chromosomes in sex cells (sperm and egg cells) is what fraction of that in body cells?
受精后染色体数目又恢复为体细胞的数目。: After fertilisation the number of chromosomes returns to that of a body cell.
人的体细胞中有 23 对染色体，精子中有多少条？: Human body cells have 23 pairs of chromosomes. How many are there in a sperm?
精子和卵细胞各有 23 条。: A sperm and an egg cell each have 23 chromosomes.
控制相对性状的一对基因叫什么？: What is a pair of genes that control a pair of contrasting traits called?
一个来自父亲，一个来自母亲。: One comes from the father and one from the mother.
用 A 表示显性基因，a 表示隐性基因，表现隐性性状的基因组成是？: Let A stand for the dominant gene and a for the recessive gene. What gene combination shows the recessive trait?
基因组成是 $Aa$ 的个体表现出？: An individual with the gene combination $Aa$ shows...
显性基因 A 掩盖了隐性基因 a。: The dominant gene A masks the recessive gene a.
$Aa$ 和 $Aa$ 的个体结婚，后代出现隐性性状的概率是？: If an $Aa$ individual marries another $Aa$ individual, what is the probability that a child shows the recessive trait?
后代基因型 AA、Aa、aa 的比例是 1:2:1。: The ratio of genotypes AA, Aa and aa in the children is 1:2:1.
$AA$ 和 $aa$ 的个体杂交，子一代的基因组成是？: If $AA$ and $aa$ individuals are crossed, what is the gene combination of the first generation?
子一代全部表现显性性状。: The whole first generation shows the dominant trait.
我国法律禁止近亲结婚，是因为？: Why does Chinese law forbid marriage between close relatives?
后代患遗传病的机会增大: The chance of children having genetic diseases goes up
近亲携带相同隐性致病基因的可能性大。: Close relatives are more likely to carry the same recessive disease genes.
感情不好: They do not get on well
没有共同语言: They have nothing to talk about
白化病属于哪种疾病？: What kind of disease is albinism?
由隐性致病基因引起。: It is caused by a recessive disease gene.
色盲是一种？: Colour blindness is a kind of...
色盲的基因在 X 染色体上，男性患者多于女性。: The colour blindness gene is on the X chromosome, and there are more male patients than female.
杂交水稻之父是谁？: Who is the father of hybrid rice?
他培育的杂交水稻让更多人吃饱饭。: The hybrid rice he developed has let more people have enough to eat.
青蒿素是由谁发现的，可用来治疗什么？: Who discovered artemisinin, and what can it be used to treat?
她因此获得了诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。: She won the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for it.
转基因技术是把什么转入另一种生物体内？: What does transgenic technology transfer into another organism?
抗虫棉就是转基因的成果。: Insect-resistant cotton is a result of transgenic technology.
克隆羊“多莉”是用什么技术培育的？: With what technology was the cloned sheep "Dolly" produced?
克隆是无性生殖，后代的遗传物质与供核者相同。: Cloning is asexual reproduction, and the offspring have the same genetic material as the nucleus donor.
试管婴儿的受精过程发生在哪里？: Where does fertilisation take place in test-tube babies?
体外（试管中）: Outside the body (in a test tube)
受精卵发育成胚胎后，再移回母体子宫。: After the fertilised egg develops into an embryo, it is put back into the mother's uterus.
下列属于特异性免疫的是？: Which of these is specific immunity?
特异性免疫只针对某种病原体。: Specific immunity is aimed only at one kind of pathogen.
下列属于非特异性免疫的是？: Which of these is non-specific immunity?
皮肤和黏膜的屏障作用: The barrier effect of the skin and mucous membranes
非特异性免疫对多种病原体都有防御作用。: Non-specific immunity defends against many kinds of pathogens.
得过麻疹后不再得: Not catching measles again after having had it
能引起人体产生抗体的物质叫什么？: What is a substance that makes the human body produce antibodies called?
病原体、移植的器官都可以是抗原。: Pathogens and transplanted organs can both be antigens.
人体的第一道防线是什么？: What is the body's first line of defence?
第二道防线是体液中的杀菌物质和吞噬细胞。: The second line of defence is the germ-killing substances in body fluids and phagocytes.
人体的第三道防线主要是？: What is the body's third line of defence mainly?
免疫器官和免疫细胞: The immune organs and immune cells
它属于特异性免疫，是后天形成的。: It is specific immunity and is formed after birth.
传染病具有哪两个基本特点？: What are the two basic features of infectious diseases?
传染性和流行性: Infectiousness and the ability to spread in epidemics
遗传性和流行性: Heredity and the ability to spread in epidemics
传染病流行的三个基本环节是？: What are the three basic links in the spread of an infectious disease?
传染源、传播途径、易感人群: The source of infection, the route of transmission and the susceptible population
切断任意一个环节就能预防传染病。: Cutting any one link can prevent an infectious disease.
对传染病患者进行隔离，属于哪项措施？: Isolating patients with an infectious disease is which measure?
早发现、早隔离、早治疗。: Find early, isolate early, treat early.
讲究卫生、消毒、杀灭蚊蝇，属于哪项措施？: Paying attention to hygiene, disinfecting and killing mosquitoes and flies is which measure?
勤洗手、戴口罩、通风都属于这一类。: Washing hands often, wearing masks and ventilating all belong to this kind.
锻炼身体、接种疫苗，属于哪项措施？: Taking exercise and getting vaccinated is which measure?
保护易感人群，提高抵抗力。: Protecting the susceptible population and raising resistance.
艾滋病的病原体是？: What is the pathogen of AIDS?
艾滋病主要通过血液、性接触和母婴传播，日常接触不传播。: AIDS spreads mainly through blood, sexual contact and from mother to child, and not through everyday contact.
抗生素对下列哪种病原体有效？: Against which of these pathogens are antibiotics effective?
感冒大多由病毒引起，抗生素无效。: Most colds are caused by viruses, and antibiotics do not work on them.
药物的“OTC”标志表示？: What does the "OTC" mark on a medicine mean?
非处方药可以自己购买，但要看说明书。: Non-prescription medicine can be bought by yourself, but you must read the instructions.
遇到心跳呼吸骤停的人，应当怎样急救？: How should you give first aid to a person whose heart and breathing have stopped?
胸外按压要有节奏，每分钟约 100 次。: Chest compressions should have a rhythm of about 100 a minute.
动脉出血的特点是？: What is the feature of bleeding from an artery?
血色鲜红，喷射状流出: The blood is bright red and spurts out
要在伤口的近心端止血。: Stop the bleeding on the heart side of the wound.
静脉出血时，应在伤口的哪一侧止血？: When a vein is bleeding, on which side of the wound should the bleeding be stopped?
远心端: The side away from the heart
静脉血流向心脏，所以压迫远心端。: Venous blood flows towards the heart, so press on the side away from the heart.
毒品对人体的危害主要是？: What is the main harm of drugs to the human body?
损害神经系统，使人成瘾: They damage the nervous system and cause addiction
远离毒品，珍爱生命。: Stay away from drugs and cherish life.
生物多样性不包括？: Which of these is NOT part of biodiversity?
生物多样性是人类生存的基础。: Biodiversity is the foundation of human survival.
保护生物多样性最有效的措施是？: What is the most effective measure for protecting biodiversity?
迁地保护（动物园）和法律保护是补充。: Protection outside the natural habitat (zoos) and legal protection are supplements.
我国特有的珍稀哺乳动物是？: Which rare mammal is special to China?
被称为“植物活化石”的是？: Which tree is called a "living fossil among plants"?
银杏在地球上已经生存了两亿多年。: The ginkgo has existed on Earth for more than 200 million years.
外来物种入侵可能造成什么？: What can the invasion of alien species cause?
本地物种减少，生态失衡: Fewer native species and an ecological imbalance
例如水葫芦、福寿螺。: Examples are water hyacinth and the golden apple snail.
引进外来物种之前必须？: Before bringing in an alien species you must...
做好评估，防止破坏生态: Make a good assessment to avoid damaging the ecology
引进不当会破坏本地生态系统。: Improper introduction damages the local ecosystem.
生态系统具有一定的自我调节能力，这是因为？: An ecosystem has some ability to regulate itself. This is because...
生物种类和数量保持相对稳定: The kinds and numbers of living things stay relatively stable
生物种类越多，自我调节能力越强。: The more kinds of living things, the stronger the ability to regulate itself.
食物链很简单: The food chains are very simple
在“草→鼠→蛇→鹰”食物链中，若蛇大量减少，短期内会？: In the food chain "grass → mouse → snake → eagle", if the snakes greatly decrease, what happens in the short term?
捕食者减少，被捕食者往往会增多。: When predators decrease, the prey often increase.
生物富集：有毒物质沿食物链？: Biomagnification: poisonous substances along the food chain...
逐级积累增加: Build up and increase at each step
所以处在食物链顶端的生物受害最大。: So the living things at the top of the food chain are harmed the most.
能量在食物链中的传递效率大约是？: About what is the efficiency of energy transfer along a food chain?
所以食物链一般不超过 4～5 级。: So a food chain generally does not go beyond 4-5 levels.
下列属于生物影响环境的是？: Which of these is an example of living things affecting the environment?
生物既适应环境，也影响环境。: Living things both adapt to the environment and affect it.
下列属于生物适应环境的是？: Which of these is an example of living things adapting to the environment?
骆驼刺的根很长: The very long roots of camel thorn
沙漠里的植物根系发达，才能吸到深处的水。: Plants in deserts have well-developed root systems so that they can reach water deep down.
下列属于非生物因素的是？: Which of these is an abiotic factor?
光、温度、水、空气、土壤都是非生物因素。: Light, temperature, water, air and soil are all abiotic factors.
北极熊的皮下脂肪很厚，说明了什么？: A polar bear has a thick layer of fat under its skin. What does this show?
生物对环境的适应: The adaptation of living things to the environment
厚厚的脂肪帮助它保暖。: The thick fat helps keep it warm.
人类活动对生态系统最大的影响之一是？: What is one of the greatest effects of human activity on ecosystems?
保护环境就是保护我们自己。: Protecting the environment is protecting ourselves.
光合作用的公式是？: What is the equation for photosynthesis?
二氧化碳＋水 →（光、叶绿体）有机物＋氧气: Carbon dioxide + water → (light, chloroplasts) organic matter + oxygen
光合作用储存能量，呼吸作用释放能量。: Photosynthesis stores energy and respiration releases energy.
有机物＋氧气 → 二氧化碳＋水: Organic matter + oxygen → carbon dioxide + water
呼吸作用的公式是？: What is the equation for respiration?
有机物＋氧气 → 二氧化碳＋水＋能量: Organic matter + oxygen → carbon dioxide + water + energy
所有活细胞都在进行呼吸作用。: All living cells are carrying out respiration.
二氧化碳＋水 → 有机物＋氧气: Carbon dioxide + water → organic matter + oxygen
在“绿叶在光下制造有机物”实验中，滴碘液后变蓝说明有？: In the experiment "green leaves make organic matter in light", the leaf turning blue after iodine solution is added shows there is...
事先要把叶片放进酒精中隔水加热脱去叶绿素。: Beforehand the leaf has to be heated in alcohol in a water bath to remove the chlorophyll.
在“绿叶在光下制造有机物”实验中，为什么要把植物先放在黑暗处一昼夜？: In the experiment "green leaves make organic matter in light", why is the plant first put in the dark for a day and a night?
让叶片中原有的淀粉运走耗尽: To let the starch already in the leaves be carried away and used up
这样才能证明淀粉是实验时新制造的。: This is how to prove that the starch was newly made during the experiment.
提高大棚蔬菜产量，可以采取的措施是？: What measure can increase the yield of vegetables in a greenhouse?
增加光照和二氧化碳浓度: Increasing the light and the carbon dioxide concentration
合理密植也能提高光能利用率。: Sensible close planting can also raise the use of light energy.
降低温度到零度: Lowering the temperature to zero degrees
贮存蔬菜水果时，降低温度是为了？: When storing vegetables and fruit, why is the temperature lowered?
低温下呼吸作用弱，有机物消耗少。: At low temperature respiration is weak and less organic matter is used up.
农田松土主要是为了？: What is loosening the soil in fields mainly for?
促进根的呼吸作用: To promote respiration of the roots
根需要氧气才能进行呼吸。: Roots need oxygen in order to respire.
植物吸收的水分绝大部分用于？: What is the great majority of the water that plants take up used for?
约 99% 的水分通过蒸腾散失到大气中。: About 99% of the water is lost to the air through transpiration.
肾单位的组成是？: What is a nephron made of?
肾小体和肾小管: A renal corpuscle and a renal tubule
肾小体由肾小球和肾小囊组成。: The renal corpuscle is made of the glomerulus and the renal capsule.
肾小球和肾小囊: The glomerulus and the renal capsule
肾小管和输尿管: The renal tubule and the ureter
肾盂和膀胱: The renal pelvis and the bladder
尿液形成的两个过程是？: What are the two processes by which urine is formed?
血液经肾小球滤过成原尿，原尿经肾小管重吸收成尿液。: Blood is filtered by the glomerulus into primary urine, and the primary urine is reabsorbed by the tubule into urine.
健康人的尿液中不含有什么？: What does the urine of a healthy person NOT contain?
若尿中有葡萄糖，可能是糖尿病。: If there is glucose in the urine, it may be diabetes.
人体排出体内废物的途径不包括？: Which of these is NOT a way the human body gets rid of waste?
排便是排遗，不是排泄。: Defecation is the removal of undigested waste, not excretion.
眼球中形成物像的是？: What in the eyeball forms the image?
视觉形成在大脑的视觉中枢。: Vision is formed in the visual centre of the brain.
眼球中，相当于照相机镜头的是？: In the eyeball, what is equivalent to the lens of a camera?
晶状体曲度能随远近调节。: The curvature of the lens can adjust with distance.
看近处物体时，晶状体的曲度？: When looking at a near object, the curvature of the lens...
睫状肌收缩使晶状体变凸。: The ciliary muscle contracts and makes the lens bulge.
大脑的听觉中枢: The auditory centre of the brain
耳蜗里有接受声音刺激的感觉细胞。: The cochlea has sensory cells that receive sound stimuli.
人体中调节生命活动的两个主要系统是？: What are the two main systems that regulate life activities in the human body?
神经系统和内分泌系统: The nervous system and the endocrine system
神经调节快速，激素调节持久。: Nervous regulation is fast and hormone regulation is lasting.
消化系统和呼吸系统: The digestive system and the respiratory system
循环系统和泌尿系统: The circulatory system and the urinary system
运动系统和生殖系统: The locomotor system and the reproductive system
幼年时甲状腺激素不足会得呆小症。: Too little thyroid hormone in childhood causes cretinism.
幼年时生长激素分泌过多会患？: Too much growth hormone in childhood causes...
成年后分泌过多会患肢端肥大症。: Too much in adulthood causes acromegaly.
酸雨对植物的危害是？: What is the harm of acid rain to plants?
破坏叶片，使土壤酸化: It damages the leaves and makes the soil acid
酸雨主要由煤燃烧产生的二氧化硫引起。: Acid rain is mainly caused by the sulfur dioxide produced by burning coal.
保护环境，我们提倡？: To protect the environment, what do we advocate?
低碳生活、垃圾分类: A low-carbon life and waste sorting
绿色出行从身边小事做起。: Green travel starts with small things around us.
显微镜下视野较暗时，应该怎样调节？: When the field of view under a microscope is dark, how should it be adjusted?
用大光圈、凹面镜: Use a large aperture and the concave mirror
反光镜的凹面能聚光。: The concave side of the mirror can gather light.
用小光圈、平面镜: Use a small aperture and the plane mirror
换小物镜: Change to a smaller objective lens
显微镜的放大倍数等于？: What is the magnification of a microscope equal to?
放大倍数越大，视野越暗、看到的细胞越少。: The greater the magnification, the darker the field of view and the fewer cells you see.
制作洋葱鳞片叶表皮临时装片，要滴什么液？: When making a temporary slide of onion scale-leaf epidermis, what liquid should be dropped on?
清水，染色用碘液: Clean water, and iodine solution for staining
观察人的口腔上皮细胞时要滴生理盐水。: When observing human cheek epithelial cells, drop on physiological saline.
观察人的口腔上皮细胞时，载玻片上要滴？: When observing human cheek epithelial cells, what is dropped on the slide?
0.9% 的生理盐水能保持细胞的形态。: 0.9% physiological saline keeps the shape of the cells.
